scope: Read-only excerpts of saved local metrics and audits. No new model calls, source dataset, credentials or raw requests. Each excerpt key is a JSON Pointer into the hashed source.
metric_notes: F1 and accuracy values are fractions, not percentages. Original field names and counts are retained.
Missing GT is excluded per task. all_valid_heads_exact is not necessarily all five heads when masks are incomplete.
Different cohorts and H0 versions must not be pooled or ranked directly.
Historical and cumulative costs, native billing, estimates, reservations and cache hits must not be added as fresh charges.
Some unpriced_calls fields include Qwen responses with usage but no native bill; they differ from calls missing usage.
D2/D3 snapshots alone do not establish actual API rounds.
Recent threshold 3.5 is an offline shadow on the threshold-4 trajectory, not a separate closed-loop experiment.
A source hash identifies a retained local artifact; it does not replace raw data or independent public reproduction.

/historical_cost.note: Historical billed usage; replay makes zero new calls. Missing prices are not zero cost.

excerpts./scope: first two eligible targets; other rows retain H0
